text.p: The following are top headlines from selected Canadian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
THE GLOBE AND MAIL: Mercenaries eye Sierra Leone: Vancouver company helps ousted government plot countercoup in the land of diamonds
Medicare gives poor a better chance: Cancer-survival rate worse in U.S.
AFN's new chief means business: Fontaine to seek broader alliances
AT&T answer Nova Scotia's call: Halifax will be site of 1,000 job, $9-million telecommunications centre
Blair's blazing pace startles staid U.K.: PM make the most of first 100 days
Morin gets full apology from chief
Report on Business Section: Suncor unveils huge expansion: $2.2-billion project will more than double synthetic crude output by Alberta oil sands plant
AECL snags nuclear waste deal in Lithuania: Foothold gained in lucrative Baltics
Scotiabank forced to extend National Trustco bid: Fails to secure federal approval for $1.25-billion deal in time
Vending machines just joking around: Did you hear the one about the pair of entrepreneurs who had an idea that kept them laughing all the way to the bank?
